title.narrative: Accelerating Decarbonization: Closing the Energy Gap through Market-Driven Solar Power Solutions

description.narrative: The project aims to install 30 MW of hybrid solar PV systems and strengthen the enabling environment to develop part of Bhutan’s 12 GW solar energy potential. The project's impact is the creation of a functional energy market to gradually realize Bhutan’s solar energy potential, supporting the nation's carbon neutrality commitment and escalating energy needs. Four supportive outcomes include enhanced policy and regulation to enable a functioning energy market, a Green Financing Framework (GFF) increasing capital flow for Energy Service Companies (ESCOs), a single-window technical support center providing advisory services to ESCOs, and hospitals with access to solar energy, making their services resilient to power grid disruptions. Project outputs include attractive regulatory and policy frameworks, a functional GFF, a blended finance mechanism for ESCOs and social businesses, and the installation of 30 MW of solar in 49 health facilities, reducing 1.4 million tonnes of CO2e.
